summary: Per OpenAI's API changelog entry dated Oct 28, 2026, eligible ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers can claim up to $500 per month in free API credits. The benefit is activated from ChatGPT or the API Platform by linking an API organization the subscriber owns. The changelog points to a guide at developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/chatgpt-api-credits for credit amounts and eligibility (not loaded within budget).
claim_steps: Hold an eligible ChatGPT Pro or Business subscription
Activate the benefit from ChatGPT or the API Platform
Link an API organization you own to receive the credits
